changelog:
pontx-frankfurter-v2 v1.0.1

- Initial release integrating Frankfurter v2 via Pontx for daily reference FX rates and central-bank tasks
- Supports provider selection, compliance, and auditable time series with attribution
- Guidance for safe, compliant rate retrieval, attribution retention, and proper audit logging
- Recommends inspecting live contract metadata for endpoints and commands, avoiding hardcoded usage
- Outlines workflows for display conversion, regulated invoices, and large-scale attributed history exports
summary: Integrate Frankfurter v2 through Pontx for reference-rate conversion, provider-pinned compliance, auditable time series, attribution, and large exports. Use for FX or central-bank rate tasks.
